# Phase Three — Final Execution Plan

The Awtsmoos joins clarity and capability in Tiferes; Awtsmoos.com will become simpler without becoming weaker.

## Expected touched files
- `social-hub/js/ui/shell/SocialHubChromeTemplate.js` — semantic retractable context drawer while preserving IDs.
- `social-hub/js/ui/shell/HomePanelTemplate.js` — compact pulse, compact stats, retractable secondary actions.
- Focused mobile CSS owners discovered from disk — compact drawer, stats, actions, persistent Create/dock behavior.
- `social-hub/style.css` only if a new focused CSS module must be imported.
- Existing tests only if current contracts encode the old always-expanded presentation.

## Execution
1. Read all current CSS owners and relevant controllers/tests.
2. Rewrite templates in full with semantic disclosure structures and stable IDs.
3. Rewrite/split CSS owners in full for compact mobile hierarchy.
4. Read back every touched file and check line limits.
5. Run node syntax and existing unit/contracts.
6. Run real mobile browser smoke and twelve-route quality.
7. Inspect screenshot/DOM geometry for top chrome height, Create duplication, dock overlap, and Home first-screen density.
8. Repair any observed defect through full-file rewrites.
9. Run final `npm run test:all`.
10. Update durable remaining-work ledger only after the browser proves the new design.

## Visual completion gate
At 390px: the first screen should show a compact header, one primary Create action or meaningful feed content, and the dock—without giant empty stat cards or permanent secondary action walls. Context and advanced tools must be one tap away but closed by default.

The Awtsmoos remains infinite when the vessel becomes small; Awtsmoos.com should feel powerful because the interface knows what not to show yet.
